From: Samir Shah <samir@edgeware.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Interest from Quickstart docs -> Requesting technical demo

Hi Marissa,

I was following the Quickstart docs on Redwood (https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart) and spun up a small proof-of-concept this morning. We evaluate different inference stacks at Edgeware Labs and I have a couple of technical questions about model quantization and batching before we move further.

Would you or someone from your team be able to do a 30-45 minute technical demo this week? Prefer afternoons PT.

A few context points:
- We’re evaluating inference for a real-time recommendation service (~50 RPS peak).
- Data residency is US only.
- Primary interest: latency optimization and cost per 1M tokens.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Platform Engineer | Edgeware Labs
samir@edgeware.ai

Hi Samir - great to hear you tried the quickstart, thanks for reaching out.

I’ve looped in Michael (solutions engineer) who can do a deep-dive on quantization and batching. Lauren (SDR manager) is on copy for scheduling.

Are you available Thursday 3/18 1:00-1:45 PM PT or Friday 3/19 11:00-11:45 AM PT? I can send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo checklist.

Quick links for reference:
- Quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart
- Batching guidance: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching

Thanks,
